key_impacts: Private and government structures were terminally damaged.
Buildings rendered uninhabitable required safe demolition.
Overwhelming quantities of debris and rubble remained in communities.
evidence_snippets: Demolition of private and government structures terminally damaged by the earthquake.
UN Volunteer civil engineers gathered at their camp in Karthali, Sindhupalchowk.

key_impacts: A 7.8‑magnitude earthquake hit the Pacific Coast of Ecuador.
UNV established a taskforce and deployed 50 volunteers as frontline responders.
evidence_snippets: 7.8‑magnitude earthquake hit the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016.
UNV established an Ecuador Earthquake Taskforce to coordinate recovery.
Fifty UN Volunteers were deployed as frontline responders.
